id.description: The unique identifier for the take-home assignment

applicationId.description: The id of the associated application

candidateId.description: The id of the associated candidate

interviewId.description: The id of the linked interview definition for this take-home

id.description: The unique identifier for the interview

title.description: The internal title of the interview

externalTitle.description: The title of the interview shown to candidates

type.description: The interview definition type, such as Interview, TakeHome, or Debrief

isDebrief.description: Whether the interview is a debrief

isFeedbackRequired.description: Whether feedback is required for this interview

isFeedbackRequested.description: Whether feedback is requested for this interview

feedbackFormDefinitionId.description: The unique identifier for the feedback form definition used by this interview

status.description: The current lifecycle status of the take-home assignment

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the take-home was created

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the take-home was last updated

id.description: The unique identifier for the take-home submission

submittedAt.description: The timestamp when the candidate submitted

fileHandles.description: The files submitted by the candidate

id.description: The unique identifier for the file

handle.description: The file handle, which can be used with the file.info endpoint

feedbackFormDefinitionId.description: The feedback form definition reviewers use for this take-home

userId.description: The id of the assigned reviewer

interviewEventId.description: The interview event id used for interview briefings and feedback submission

feedbackLink.description: The Ashby app link for submitting reviewer feedback

hasSubmittedFeedback.description: Whether this reviewer has submitted take-home feedback
